reduction.authorsMethod: Off-sky 200-pixel moving-median correlated read-noise removal; local template PSF median over10 slices each direction, background subtraction/normalization, scale plus constant background fit; per-dither 3sigma cleaning with20-pixel moving median, then average.
reduction.gonggongExtraction: 7x7 extraction box, background outside21x21, intervening pixels masked; Figure1 is wavelength-collapsed IFU diagnostic with palette/boxes, not resolved terrain. Satellite too small/faint to detect in these data.
reduction.reflectance: Divide by matched-aperture SNAP-2 PRISM solar analog program1128. P330E program1538 belongs to medium-grating context, not this Gonggong observation.
reduction.limits: Publisher pipeline/calibration claims not independently reproduced. Raw exposure IDs/MAST products, contamination budget, wavelength/photometric error reproduction and precise native Hubble crosswalk remain open. No transfer of Quaoar medium-grating observations/chemistry to Gonggong.

bandAnalysis.method: Local linear continuum and Gaussian fits; averages/std deviations of10000 Monte Carlo fits. Continuum shape/slope, blended bands and non-Gaussian shapes excluded from quoted uncertainties, potentially underestimating true errors.
bandAnalysis.quantities: Band depth percent of local continuum is not local material fraction, abundance, visible colour or resolved terrain. Detailed spectral mixture/particle/layering models explicitly deferred.

water.caveat: Asymmetric band: Gaussian center may not precisely represent true center.

bandAnalysis.tableFootnotes: 3.375/3.419/3.488 bands lie within broad deep2.7–3.6micron complex; width/depth depend on local continuum. 3.488 also sits on steep continuum and fit may be unreliable.

gonggongInterpretations.ethane: Multiple2.25–2.5 and3.35–3.5micron features support C2H6. Differences around3.42/3.49 may involve mixing or another hydrocarbon; propane has overlapping bands. Weaker/missing longer-wave features imply lower relative ethane than Sedna, not a quantified local fraction.
gonggongInterpretations.methane: Very little direct evidence in this PRISM spectrum; strong expected3.32/3.55/3.85 features not apparent. Weak~2.60 feature and ethane overlaps allow possible small contributions; nondetection is not absolute absence.
gonggongInterpretations.water: 1.5/2.0micron bands,1.65micron crystalline feature and4–5micron curvature support H2O. Missing3.1micron Fresnel peak admits amorphous surface layering, water-depleted top layer or acetylene overprint alternatives; none is a resolved measured layer/geography.
gonggongInterpretations.carbonDioxide: 4.253micron feature may be CO2 complexed with dark material or other ices; not an unambiguous pure-CO2 terrain or local fraction. Ganymede/Callisto/Saturn moon analog comparisons are not skins.
gonggongInterpretations.organics: Red slope and broad absorption suggest complex organics. Irradiation, replenishment, internal melting/geochemical evolution and atmospheric scenarios are interpretations, not direct plume/ocean/biology/atmospheric measurements or photographed geography.
